items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The Brady Street Orchestra and [sounds like] Barry Epperly was the conductor. I remember that night ‘cause I was impressed with your playing.
